Admins can now create teams. There is a `POST /teams` mock handler, a Teams page at `/app/teams`, and an admin-only "Teams" link in the side navigation. I did not run tests, lint, type check or the app, as you asked, so none of this is verified.

**What changed** (all under `apps/react-vite/src`):

- **Mock API** (`testing/mocks/handlers/teams.ts`): `POST /teams` takes `name` and `description` and returns the created team with its id and creation date. It returns 401 when signed out, 403 for non-admins, and 400 when either field is blank. It picks the two fields explicitly, so a client cannot set `id` or `createdAt`.
- **API and form** (`features/teams/api/create-team.ts`, `features/teams/components/create-team.tsx`): a Zod schema requiring both fields, a `useCreateTeam` mutation that refreshes the teams list, and a "Create Team" button that opens a form drawer. The success toast says "Team Created".
- **Teams list** (`features/teams/components/teams-list.tsx`): a table of name, description and created date, reusing the existing `useTeams` query.
- **Page** (`app/routes/app/teams.tsx`): admin-only, with the same "Only admin can view this." fallback as the Users page. It is registered in `router.tsx` and `config/paths.ts`.
- **Navigation** (`components/layouts/dashboard-layout.tsx`): a "Teams" link after "Users", shown to admins only.
- **Test** (`app/routes/app/__tests__/teams.test.tsx`): one integration test that creates a team through the drawer, then checks the toast and the new row. The project rules ask for a test with new behaviour, so I wrote one, but I have not run it.

**Choices I made:**

- The mock returns **403** to non-admins. The existing discussion handlers throw from `requireAdmin` and so return 500, which I think is wrong, but I did not change them.
- Creating a team does not add the creator to it. Users belong to exactly one team, so the admin stays in their own team.

**Things to decide:**

- **Team list visibility.** `GET /teams` already returns every team, and the Teams page lists all of them. The product rules say users only see their own team's data, but names and descriptions are not members, discussions or comments. Tell me if you want the list narrowed.
- **Docs not updated.** The dashboard's admin list and the `CLAUDE.md` action table do not mention team creation. The roadmap also lists it as planned. I left those alone because they are team-owned docs.
- **Nothing committed.** The changes are in the working tree on `bench`.
